subject: ART-RIVER collar review repair active; v2 files preserved, expect v3 hashes
body: Read scrum-river-candidate-review.md. Rich raised style and geometry retained; smooth rectangular join collars need repair. ART-RIVER reclaimed. Generating a matching quiet water texture with imagegen and refining irregular feather masks while keeping shared mouth centre/width/edge pixels. Current v2 runtime/source/QA files and exact manifest saved in qa/collar-before; do not treat those visual candidates as accepted. Revised assets will use v3 paths and updated manifest hashes, avoiding changes under an existing v2 import. No builder/global files or gameplay/topology edits.
